crossRefs.note: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.
Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”
Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”
for we walk by faith, not by sight.
Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
By faith, he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
These all, having had testimony given to them through their faith, didn’t receive the promise,
whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Thomas
people.line: One of Jesus' twelve disciples, known for doubting

translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen, and have believed.”
translations.bsb: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen Me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.”
translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
translations.asv: Jesus saith unto him, Because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
